paragraphs: Sanhedrin 52b relates that Imarta daughter of Tali, a priest’s daughter, committed adultery; Rav Chama bar Tuviah surrounded her with bundles of vine shoots and burned her.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Sanhedrin 52b paragraph has Imarta bat Talei and Chama bar Toviyyah, with Rav in parentheses, and describes bundles of vine shoots. Hyman’s stated form of the name and title is retained.
